import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Calendar, CalendarCaption, CalendarCell, CalendarDay, CalendarGrid, CalendarHeading, CalendarMonth, CalendarMonths, CalendarNav, CalendarNext, CalendarPrevious, CalendarWeek, CalendarWeekday, CalendarWeekdays, } from '@/ui/calendar/calendar'; /** * Several dates chosen at once; choosing a date again removes it. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-calendar-multiple', imports: [ Calendar, CalendarCaption, CalendarCell, CalendarDay, CalendarGrid, CalendarHeading, CalendarMonth, CalendarMonths, CalendarNav, CalendarNext, CalendarPrevious, CalendarWeek, CalendarWeekday, CalendarWeekdays, NdIcon, ], template: `
@for (month of calendar.months(); track month.key) {
{{ month.label }}
@for (weekday of calendar.weekdays(); track weekday.long) { } @for (week of month.weeks; track week.key) { @for (day of week.days; track day.key) { } }
{{ weekday.short }}
}

{{ dates().length }} dates chosen.

`, }) export class CalendarMultipleExample { protected readonly dates = signal([]); }
